title: 361. Binary Tree Paths

examples.explanation: The two leaves are 5 and 3, reached by 1 -> 2 -> 5 and 1 -> 3.
The root is itself a leaf, so the only path is "1".
The single chain from the root to the deepest leaf forms one path.
